gloss: right wing (politics); right flank (military); right field (baseball)

definitions.explanation: Conservative or nationalist political ideology, or a person or group holding such views.
The right side of a military formation or sports field. In baseball, refers to right field or right fielder.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{団体|だんたい}がデモを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: A right-wing organization held a demonstration.

examples.japanese: その{政党|せいとう}は{右翼|うよく}{寄|よ}りの{政策|せいさく}を{掲|かか}げている。
examples.english: That political party advocates right-leaning policies.

examples.japanese: ヨーロッパでは{近年|きんねん}、{右翼|うよく}ポピュリズムが{台頭|たいとう}し、{移民|いみん}{政策|せいさく}をめぐる{議論|ぎろん}が{活発|かっぱつ}になっている。
examples.english: In recent years, right-wing populism has risen in Europe, and debate over immigration policy has become more active.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}にフライが{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: A fly ball went to right field.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{右翼手|うよくしゅ}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: He is playing an active role as a right fielder.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}の{右翼|うよく}が{手薄|てうす}だったので、そこから{攻|せ}めることにした。
examples.english: The enemy's right flank was thinly defended, so we decided to attack from there.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {右翼|うよく} in a political sense often refers to ultranationalist groups, some of which are known for driving black propaganda trucks ({街宣車|がいせんしゃ}) through cities. The term can refer to the political ideology in general or to organized groups specifically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右翼|うよく}{団体|だんたい}: right-wing organization
- {右翼|うよく}{思想|しそう}: right-wing ideology
- {右翼|うよく}{寄|よ}り: right-leaning
- {右翼手|うよくしゅ}: right fielder (baseball)
- {極右|きょくう}: far right

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is {左翼|さよく} (left wing). {保守|ほしゅ} (conservative) is a more neutral term for right-leaning political views, while {右翼|うよく} can carry a stronger, more ideological connotation.
